name: Camping 101: Mining
summary: A mining instructor in Shen'dar Village can teach you to craft a Lodestone for your camp. It gives those gathered around the fire extra strength in combat.

sections.title: A Miner's Craft
sections.body: Mining offers honest work, and you can learn a camp craft through Messana Crestwind in Shen'dar Village. Once you have shown proficiency in mining, she can teach you to make a Lodestone. Those who gather around your fire can draw extra strength from it, so the craft may bring sword-wielders to your camp.

sections.title: A Place to Camp
sections.body: With the craft learned, you can make your own Lodestone. Camps are unwelcome in the center of town, so take it into the wilderness to test it. A campfire is needed before you set up camp, and a cook can teach you how to make one.

faq.q: Who teaches me to make a Lodestone?
faq.answer: Messana Crestwind in Shen'dar Village can teach you to craft a Lodestone after you show proficiency in mining.
It gives those gathered around your campfire extra strength in combat.

faq.q: Where can I test my Lodestone?
faq.answer: You can test it in the wilderness; camps are unwelcome in the center of town.
Yes. You need a campfire before setting up camp, and a cook can teach you to make one.

faq.q: What do I need before Messana teaches me?
faq.answer: You need to show proficiency in mining before Messana Crestwind can teach you to craft a Lodestone.

angles.text: As a miner, you can show your proficiency to Messana Crestwind and learn to craft a Lodestone for your camp.
As a cook, you can teach others to make the campfire needed to set up camp.
